lines.text: Many learners say: I do not like tea. Me too.
Better: I do not like tea. Me neither.
Neither! I do not like tea. Me neither.

data.wrong: I do not like tea. Me too.
data.right: I do not like tea. Me neither.

quiz.stem: I do not like tea. Me ___.

native.tip: 한국어 ‘나도’는 긍정에도 부정에도 쓰여서 me too가 나오기 쉬워요. 부정문에 맞장구칠 땐 “Me neither.”예요.
native.caption: “I do not like tea. Me too.”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어 ‘나도 안 좋아해’는 ‘나도’를 그대로 me too로 옮기기 쉬워요. 부정하는 말에 맞장구칠 땐 neither를 써요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “I do not like tea. Me neither.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “neither”! 부정에는 me neither! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: After a negative sentence, say me neither. Say “I do not like tea. Me neither.”
en.caption: Do you say “I do not like tea. Me too.” in English? 😅 After a no, we agree with neither, not too. “I do not like tea. Me neither.” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
